resources.string: Import ZIP (lessons and graph) or JSON (one lesson). Export selected lessons and graph as ZIP.\n\nFiles are not included; some dependencies may be missing. Exports contain private history and hidden answers. Lessons continue with your local model settings.
Export cancelled. No lessons were changed.
Could not export. Stop generation and graph extraction, select up to 100 available lessons, and try again. Their graph data must be compatible.
Ready to import. For different versions, choose which to use. Both originals are kept locally.
Could not import. The file may be unsupported, or the library may have changed. No partial import was saved. Try importing the file again.
Imported: %1$d new or updated lessons. Identical lessons were not duplicated.
Could not save the export. The destination may contain a partial file.
